entry.title: My Active Directory Enumeration Checklist
entry.summary: Most Active Directory compromises are not about a fancy exploit. They are about one small mistake that enumeration shows you. This is the checklist I follow at the start of every internal test or lab, once I have a first set of domain credentials.

entry.title: From Developer to Pentester: My Road to OSCP+ and CPTS
entry.summary: I started as a full-stack developer. I write C# and ASP.NET Core on the backend and React with TypeScript on the frontend. In 2026 I passed HTB CPTS in July and OSCP+ in September. This post is about how that road looked and what I learned.
